svg.title: Dragon Database — DB Swordmaw Flame
svg.desc: A silver-and-black crossed-sword dragon DB emblem paired with black Dragon Database lettering based on Grenze Gotisch at weight 900. The lettering is outlined for consistent artwork; the matching font family is included for live application text.
svg.metadata: Wordmark family: Grenze Gotisch; weight: 900; original font file: fonts/grenze-gotisch/GrenzeGotisch[wght].ttf
